digest.component_or_area: fsck command cluster (_commands/fsck.py and related modules)
propositions: fsck.py is pinned at exactly 800/800 lines (the hard cap) and cannot accept any changes without refactoring
fsck.py fuses four distinct concerns: per-ticket store walk, tracker-level health checks, JSON report shaping, and CLI/argv handling plus repair hand-off
the module grows monotonically with each new check addition because all concerns remain fused, creating recurring near-cap situations
refactoring separates concerns along existing call-graph seams into fsck_scan.py (enumeration and per-ticket validators) and fsck_tracker_health.py (tracker-level health checks)

external callers import fsck module attributes for _scan, _check_snapshot, _tracker_sync_status, _foreign_store_paths, _resolve_tracker_git_dir, and foreign_store_path_list; re-exports preserve backward compatibility
complexity ratchet baseline must not register new entries; decomposing functions under C901 threshold retires 43 points of recorded debt rather than relocating it
